svg.title: Tremor Scroll: the faceless row
svg.desc: The faceless row: a stretch of the scroll over seven days. Above, the squirrel's hours as the Scroll House records them, each burst with its face arrow. Below, the row Fenn kept at home in cold chalk grey: small ticks with no arrow at all, thicker on the warm days, and two places where a face was drawn and scraped off again.
svg.text: It has no face. I gave it one twice, to make it fit. I scraped them off.
